quarterly_data.quarter: Cloudflare press release: Cloudflare Expands Support for AI Coding Agents with Cursor (09-02-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Cloudflare announced support for running Cursor Cloud Agents on Cloudflare Sandboxes: with Cursor Self-Hosted Machines, Cursor keeps running the agent loop (inference, planning, orchestration) while the agent's tool calls run in a sandbox in the customer's own Cloudflare account. It builds on Cloudflare's work with other agent platforms, including Devin Outposts and Claude Managed Agents. CTO Dane Knecht: another step toward making Cloudflare the execution layer for agentic applications.
